title: Dell Alienware Command Center (AWCC), versions prior to 6.14.105.0, contain an Improper… (CVE-2026-111519)
description: Dell Alienware Command Center (AWCC) versions prior to 6.14.105.0 have an improper authorization vulnerability in the handler for a custom URL scheme. This flaw could allow a high-privileged attacker with remote access to perform client-side request forgery and disclose information. The vulnerability has a low CVSS score and no known exploits in the wild.
